title: Freelancing on Upwork
sa_note: Check the platform's current terms for South African eligibility and payout options before registering.
cost_note: Do not pay anyone outside the platform to 'unlock' work. Read the platform's current fee page.
steps: Open the official website (check the spelling in the address bar)
Tap Sign Up and choose the freelancer option
Type a clearly fictional demo email on paper first, e.g. demo@example.com - use YOUR real details only when you register yourself
Complete your profile: skills, photo, rate and a short description
Browse jobs and send a short, specific proposal
warning: Never pay a client to start a job, and never move payment off-platform for a stranger.

title: Selling a service on Fiverr
sa_note: Check the platform's current terms for South African eligibility and payout options before registering.
cost_note: Read the platform's current fee and payout pages before publishing a service.
steps: Open the official website (check the spelling in the address bar)
Choose Become a Seller / Start Selling
Use your own real details when YOU register - demo screens in this video use fictional placeholders and are never submitted
Create one clear service ('gig'): title, price, delivery time, examples of your work
Deliver on time and ask happy clients for an honest review
warning: Avoid anyone asking you to pay for reviews or to work outside the platform.

title: Starting a YouTube channel
sa_note: Monetisation has subscriber/watch-time requirements and policy checks - read the official page linked in the description.
cost_note: You can start with a phone. Do not buy subscribers or views.
steps: Open the official YouTube monetisation page and read the requirements
Create your channel around one clear topic you know well
Post consistently and watch your analytics to see what viewers finish
Apply for monetisation only when you meet the official requirements
warning: Income is never guaranteed and usually takes time. Anyone selling guaranteed earnings is a red flag.
